messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
La tempo estis je la komenco de la mateno, kaj la suno leviĝis supren kun tiuj steloj kiuj estis kun li kiam la Dia Amo

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑conditions) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------|-------------------------------|--------| | Temp' | a period of time | **tempo** | “time” | OK | | era | existed / was | **estis** | “was” | OK | | dal | from the (introducing a locative) | **je** | “at / on” (time‑preposition) | OK | | principio | the first point | **komenco** | “beginning” | OK | | del | of the (linking noun) | **de la** | “of the” | OK | | mattino | the morning | **mateno** | “morning” | OK | | e | and (connects clauses) | **kaj** | “and” | OK | | 'l | the (definite article) | **la** | “the” | OK | | sol | the Sun | **suno** | “Sun” | OK | | montava | was mounting / moving upward (imperfect) | **leviĝis** | “rose / lifted” (perfect) | **WRONG** (aspect shift) | | 'n | (part of the idiom “'n sù”, directional) | **supren** | “upward” | **UNNECESSARY** (merged with *sù*) | | sù | upward (direction) | **supren** | “upward” | **UNNECESSARY** (merged with *'n*) | | con | together with (preposition) | **kun** | “with” | OK | | quelle | those (demonstrative) | **tiuj** | “those” | OK | | stelle | stars (celestial bodies) | **steloj** | “stars” | OK | | ch'eran | that were (relative clause) | **kiuj estis** | “that were” | OK | | con (2nd) | together with (preposition) | **kun** | “with” | OK | | lui | him (the Sun) | **li** | “him / it” | OK | | quando | when (temporal subordinator) | **kiam** | “when” | OK | | l'amor | Love (abstract noun) | **Amo** | “Love” | OK | | divino | Divine (adjective) | **Dia** | “Divine” | OK |
---
### Items to Review
- **WRONG**: *montava* → **leviĝis** (the source verb is imperfective “was mounting”; the target verb is perfective “rose”.) - **UNNECESSARY**: *'n* and *sù* → both merged into the single Esperanto adverb **supren**; the separate source tokens are not needed in the target language.
No missing source words; all have a corresponding target element.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 37** - Original: `La tempo estis je la komenco de la mateno,` - Issue: none - Corrected: `La tempo estis je la komenco de la mateno,`
- **Line 38** - Original: `kaj la suno leviĝis supren kun tiuj steloj` - Issue: **WRONG** – verb “leviĝis” expresses a completed action, while the source “montava” denotes an ongoing past action. - Corrected: `kaj la suno estis leviĝanta supren kun tiuj steloj`
- **Line 39** - Original: `kiuj estis kun li kiam la Dia Amo` - Issue: none - Corrected: `kiuj estis kun li kiam la Dia Amo`
```esperanto La tempo estis je la komenco de la mateno, kaj la suno estis leviĝanta supren kun tiuj steloj kiuj estis kun li kiam la Dia Amo ```
